BASIC_FEE().notice: Baseline LP fee applied to every swap before any penalty is         added, expressed in ppm (parts-per-million, where         1_000_000 = 100%).

MAX_PENALTY_PERCENT().notice: Upper bound on how large the penalty portion of the fee can         ever get, as a plain percentage (e.g. 10 = 10%).

PENALTY_RANGE_WIDTH().notice: Excess-ratio value (see `_getDynamicFee`) at which the         penalty is already saturated at `MAX_PENALTY_PERCENT`.

PENALTY_UNIT().notice: Conversion factor from "percent" to the ppm fee units used         internally.

PRECISION().notice: Fixed-point precision used for all ratio math below (3         decimal places, e.g. a ratio of 1.000 is stored internally         as 1000).

RATIO_THRESHOLD().notice: Ratio (priorityFee / referenceMedian) above which the         penalty starts to kick in, expressed in `PRECISION` units.

WAD().notice: Fixed-point precision used for the fractional-exponent         (`frac^1.5`) computation in `_getDynamicFee`. 1e18 = "1.0"         in WAD terms.
